skill.name: ad-creative-builder
skill.description: Generates paid advertising copy, RSA assets, hooks, and angle matrices that match verified claims on a destination landing page.

security_audit.summary: Twenty-nine static findings are Markdown formatting, metadata URLs, or documentation links without command execution or unsafe path access. One high-severity finding is confirmed because the save instruction places a user-controlled offer value into a filename without requiring sanitization. Semantic review also found that the workflow fetches a user-supplied destination URL without requiring protections against internal network access.

remediation.issue: The save filename includes the user-controlled offer value without defined sanitization.
remediation.suggestion: Convert the offer to a restricted filename slug, reject path separators, resolve the final path, and verify it remains inside memory/ad/ad-creative-builder.

remediation.issue: The destination-page workflow accepts a user-supplied URL without network destination validation.
remediation.suggestion: Allow only HTTP and HTTPS, block private and link-local addresses, validate redirects and DNS results, and require approval for unexpected hosts.

content.value_statement: Producing varied ad copy that matches landing-page claims is slow and error-prone. This skill creates format-aware variants, angle matrices, and claim annotations for review.
actual_capabilities: Generates up to 15 Google RSA headlines and four descriptions within documented character limits.
Builds matrices with at least three distinct advertising angles and multiple hooks.
Maps each ad unit to a supporting claim on the destination page.
Flags unsupported claims, guarantees, restricted wording, and other policy concerns.
Iterates existing creative while retaining user-identified winners and replacing weaker variants.
Saves a reviewed creative artifact after user confirmation.
limitations: It does not score advertising accounts or predict campaign performance.
It does not edit landing pages, upload ads, or activate campaigns.
Platform limits can change and require verification in the current advertising interface.
Reliable output requires an offer, audience, platform, destination page, and supported claims.

use_cases.title: Launch a Search Campaign
use_cases.description: Create a complete RSA asset set that matches the offer and claims on a product landing page.

use_cases.title: Plan Creative Tests
use_cases.description: Develop distinct benefit, pain, proof, and objection angles with hooks for controlled campaign experiments.

use_cases.title: Refresh Client Ads
use_cases.description: Keep proven messages, replace weak variants, and document claim support before client approval.

prompt_templates.title: Create Basic RSA Assets
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate 15 RSA headlines and four descriptions for [offer]. Use [destination URL] and target [audience]. Flag any unsupported claims.
prompt_templates.scenario: A beginner needs a complete Google Search creative set.

prompt_templates.title: Build an Angle Matrix
prompt_templates.prompt: Create three distinct angles with three hooks each for [offer] on [platform]. Match every hook to a claim from [destination URL].
prompt_templates.scenario: A marketer needs varied concepts for a new campaign.

prompt_templates.title: Improve Existing Variants
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these ad variants: [paste variants]. Retain the identified winners, replace weaker units, enforce format limits, and explain each landing-page match.
prompt_templates.scenario: A campaign manager wants a structured creative refresh.

prompt_templates.title: Produce a Controlled Test Portfolio
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a cross-format portfolio for [offer], [audiences], and [platforms]. Separate variables by test, verify claims, flag policy risks, and provide handoff notes.
prompt_templates.scenario: An advanced team needs coordinated assets and clear experiment controls.

output_examples.input: Create RSA assets for a scheduling tool with a verified 14-day trial and no credit card requirement.
output: Headline: Schedule Work in One Place
Description: Try the scheduling workspace for 14 days. No credit card is required.
Message match: The trial terms mirror the landing-page offer.

output_examples.input: Build three angles for an onboarding platform that verifies a two-day setup claim.
output: Benefit angle: Launch onboarding in two days.
Pain angle: Replace slow onboarding handoffs.
Proof angle: Use the verified two-day setup claim.
Policy note: No unsupported performance guarantee was added.

output_examples.input: Refresh losing ads while keeping the winning headline, Centralize Team Requests.
output: Replacement headline: Bring Every Request Together
Review note: Each replacement requires a matching destination-page statement.

best_practices: Provide the current destination page, target audience, platform, format, and approved claims before drafting.
Verify character counts and platform rules in the current advertising interface before import.
Test distinct angles independently so performance differences have a clear cause.
anti_patterns: Do not request statistics, testimonials, prices, deadlines, or guarantees without supporting evidence.
Do not copy competitor advertisements or treat observed competitor claims as verified facts.
Do not publish, upload, or activate generated assets before human policy and claim review.

faq.question: Which advertising formats are supported?
faq.answer: The references cover Google RSA, Performance Max text assets, Meta feed ads, and generic short-form hooks.

faq.question: Does the skill verify current platform limits?
faq.answer: It applies documented starting limits, but users must confirm current requirements in the advertising platform.

faq.question: Can it research competitor creative?
faq.answer: It can use official transparency libraries for angle research. It labels observed material and does not copy competitor creative.

faq.question: Will it invent proof for stronger copy?
faq.answer: No. Unsupported statistics, guarantees, prices, and testimonials are flagged with a source requirement.

faq.question: Can it upload or activate advertisements?
faq.answer: No. The skill produces reviewed creative artifacts and does not authorize account uploads or campaign activation.

faq.question: What happens when the destination page is missing?
faq.answer: The skill requests the missing page because message matching cannot be verified without it.
